messages:
maya: quick ping 0: onboarding for eucalyptus-embed-v0.1. fp16 looks slightly better than our prod baseline, but int8 collapse on very short queries (<5 tokens). sharing quick numbers and a minimal repro.

leo: paste numbers + command?

maya: dataset=shorttail-lite (prod short logs + synth). baseline: willow-v1 fp16 r@1=0.74 r@5=0.90; eucalyptus fp16 r@1=0.77 r@5=0.92; eucalyptus int8 (per-tensor asymmetric, CalSet50k) r@1=0.60 r@5=0.80. command used: `./quantize.sh eucalyptus-v0.1 --bits 8 --calib CalSet50k --asym`.

nora: big drop. did you try per-channel or larger calib? any norm shifts?

maya: per-channel helped a bit (r@1=0.64). CalSet200k improved +0.03. observed mean L2 norm down ~15% in int8; cosine pos pair mean drops by ~0.12. negatives stable. UMAP shows dense clump of very short alphanumeric queries.

leo: try dequantizing to fp16 then L2-normalize vs fp32 normalize path. implementation differences sometimes recover margin.

maya: tried fp16-dequant->norm and got +0.02 r@1. Also tried simple learned scale on a small validation (scale=1.18) -> r@1 from 0.60 -> 0.69 on holdout. Not production-ready but useful signal.

nora: next steps: full sweep per-channel vs per-tensor across CalSet50k/200k/1M, try 6-bit per-channel with bias corr, and evaluate 1-shot post-scaling trained on heldout. also log per-length recall and attach UMAP.

eval-bot: scheduled sweep job s-2026-03-22-18. will post results when done.

maya: will add reproduce commands + UMAP to onboarding doc and hold off int8 canary until shorttail r@1 >= 0.7. if int8 fails we'll keep fp16 for latency-critical routes and use int8 for background embed jobs.

leo: thanks, ping when sweep completes and include exact quant flags so infra can reproduce.
